visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair stands in front of a mirror, taking a selfie. She wears a brown halter dress and displays a braided ponytail with intricate scalp patterns. The background is a clean indoor room with a framed picture on the wall. (2) The scene shifts to a full-body mirror selfie in a different indoor setting. She is wearing a white tube top and wide-leg tan trousers, showing off loose braids. (3) She is seen sitting in a red car, smiling at the camera, showcasing a high bun made of braids. (4) A wide shot from a balcony overlooking a massive, congested parking lot filled with hundreds of white transport vans in an urban African city. (5) Inside 'Dallas Hair Studio', the woman sits in a styling chair, speaking directly to a handheld camera. Two Black male and female stylists are visible behind her. (6) A montage follows showing the hair washing process in a salon sink, a scalp massage, and the introduction of synthetic hair extension packs. (7) Three stylists work simultaneously on her head, meticulously braiding individual sections. The salon has wooden wall panels, mirrors, and green leaf decorations. (8) Close-ups show a yellow styling gel being applied to the roots for precision. (9) The woman is shown waiting, checking her phone, and resting her neck on a travel pillow. (10) The ends of the braids are wrapped around pink rollers and dipped into a pink basin of steaming hot water by a stylist. (11) A foam mousse is applied to the finished braids. (12) The final reveal shows the woman standing in the salon, proudly displaying her long, thin braids with curly ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks the first visual transition. (2) Vocal delivery remains energetic as the vlogger describes her location. Background music has a strong, driving synth bass. (3) A distinct splashing sound of water and a soft ambient room tone are audible during the hair washing phase. (4) The rustle of plastic is heard as synthetic hair packs are handled. The female narrator's pitch variability increases when expressing surprise. (5) A rhythmic 'ding' SFX punctuates the mention of hair extensions. The BGM maintains its consistent energetic pulse. (6) A low-frequency hum of a hairdryer is mixed underneath the narration. (7) Multiple transient 'pop' SFX are used for text pop-ups. (8) Liquid pouring and splashing sounds are prominent during the hot water treatment. (9) The audio concludes with a celebratory vocal tone and a final swell in the music's volume during the look reveal.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> List-based: Stages of a professional hair braiding process in a specific cultural context.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the vlogger's personal experience of getting a traditional African hair braiding style in Uganda, highlighting the specialized techniques, the time involved, the cost, and the final aesthetic result.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While a salon name is visible, the tone is that of a personal travel experience/review rather than a paid sponsorship.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and social-media-native subtitles to keep engagement high during a lengthy real-world process. It bridges travel and beauty content.
